excerpts.anchor: Red blood cells’ (RBC; erythrocyte and monocyte) magnesium levels are often cited
Modern dietary practices are now estimated to consist of up to 60% processed foods
marks: Processing techniques, such as grain bleaching and vegetable cooking, can cause a loss of up to 80% of magnesium content

excerpts.anchor: Gender also contributes to magnesium status as estrogen enhances magnesium utilization
marks: particularly at the time of ovulation or during oral contraceptive use
